body:
EARLY READ-ONLY REPAIR REVIEW, current uncommitted three-file delta only; no edit and not a candidate verdict.

Three construction hazards to fix before freezing:

1. ParserAttemptDecision.ModelInputObserved(value: String, checksum) retains raw story/participant text in a publicly printable enum while its receipt rendering ignores value. Compare the modelInput envelope value to the exact expected normalized input, but retain only an unforgeably derived checksum (and perhaps length) in the receipt. Otherwise default enum toString leaks source text and a caller can pair value A with checksum B without changing receipt identity.

2. AlignmentSidecarAccepted carries providerNodeIds but render/digest ignores them. The ruling says provider node IDs remain provenance, so receipt identity must change if they change. Use validated/capped typed node IDs and bind their canonical vector into the checksum/render, or make the accepted-sidecar value privately constructed so its canonical checksum is unforgeably derived from all rows. Do not keep equality fields that the digest omits.

3. The new setup-failure cases assert facts but are forgeable: ArtifactMissing(Vector.empty), PlatformIncompatible(current, Vector(current)), and ResourceBudgetInsufficient(_, required=1, available=2) all typecheck. Article IV requires the type to make the name true. Add smart-constructed nonempty/distinct component sets; nonempty supported platforms excluding current; nonnegative resource counts with required > available. Custom namespace/label values also need nonblank validation or an already validated identifier type.

The sidecar shape itself matches the upheld direction. I will wait for the admission/tests delta before judging occurrence-order and A/B/C/D courts.
